annotations.title: Federal gift tax and Form 709 checker

description: Federal gift tax and Form 709 checker — US federal gift tax check (offline): applies the annual exclusion per recipient ($19,000 in 2025 and 2026; doubled with split=true gift splitting), unlimited marital deduction or the non-citizen spouse limit, and the lifetime exclusion ($15M 2026). Returns taxable gifts, lifetime exclusion remaining, gift tax due and whether Form 709 is required. Required: gifts (comma-separated amounts per recipient, optionally name:amount). Optional: year, split, prior_taxable_gifts, to_spouse, spouse_citizen (default true). Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_gift_tax
